summary: Russia launched a large-scale overnight drone attack across multiple Ukrainian oblasts using jet-powered Geran-5 UAVs launched from approximately 400 km, targeting Kyiv, Kyiv Oblast, and central Ukraine. Ukrainian air defense downed drones over Kyiv for a second consecutive night, while a logistics facility near Boryspil belonging to Biokon company was reported burning. On the ground, Ukrainian forces from the 23rd Assault Brigade and 35th Marine Brigade liberated 4 km² of territory near Dvorichna on the Kupiansk direction, while Russian forces advanced near Holubivka and Stupochky.
key_points: Russian jet-powered Geran-5 drones were downed over Kyiv for the second consecutive night, with launches from approximately 400 km distance, per Serhiy 'Flash' Beskrestnov (Source: @UkraineNow/83864).

Ukrainian forces liberated 4 km² of territory near Dvorichna on the Kupiansk direction through joint operations of the 23rd Assault Brigade R.U.G. and 35th Separate Marine Brigade (Source: @DeepStateUA/23796).
Russian forces advanced near Holubivka and Stupochky according to DeepState map update (Source: @DeepStateUA/23793).
A logistics facility near Boryspil belonging to Biokon company was reported burning following a drone strike on the Kyiv region (Source: @UkraineNow/83859).
Moscow Mayor Sobyanin stated air defense repelled an attack of 10 UAVs over Moscow (Source: @tass_agency/393629).
The Russian Embassy in Berlin warned that deployment sites of planned German long-range systems would become legitimate military targets (Source: @tass_agency/393630).
Estonian Defense Minister Hanno Pevkur resigned after €70 million paid to Indian companies for artillery shells destined for Ukraine was not delivered (Source: @UkraineNow/83861).
Hungary again blocked EU accession negotiations for Ukraine, refusing to approve opening of the second and third negotiating clusters (Source: @tass_agency/393621).

sections.executive_summary: Russia conducted a massive overnight drone attack across central Ukraine using jet-powered Geran-5 UAVs with launches from approximately 400 km, targeting Kyiv and surrounding oblasts. Ukrainian air defense reported shooting down drones over Kyiv for the second consecutive night, though a logistics facility near Boryspil belonging to Biokon company was reported burning. On the Kupiansk direction, Ukrainian forces from the 23rd Assault Brigade and 35th Marine Brigade liberated 4 km² of territory near Dvorichna, while Russian forces advanced near Holubivka and Stupochky.

points: Ukraine's air defense downed Russian jet-powered Geran-5 drones over Kyiv for a second consecutive night. According to Serhiy 'Flash' Beskrestnov, the drones are launched from approximately 400 km and resemble cruise missiles in design, capable of speeds up to 600 km/h, carrying approximately 90 kg warheads, and with a flight range of up to 1000 km (Source: @UkraineNow/83864).
points_2: Ukrainian forces liberated 4 km² of territory near Dvorichna on the Kupiansk direction. The 23rd Assault Regiment R.U.G. of the 2nd Corps of the National Guard 'Khartiia' cleared new areas between Dvorichna and Zapadne, operating jointly with the 35th Separate Marine Brigade on one sector (Source: @DeepStateUA/23796).
points_3: Kyiv will halt vehicle traffic daily during the minute of silence at 9:00 for 60 seconds, per a decision supported by Kyiv City Council. Traffic lights will switch to 'all red' mode where technically possible, though this will not occur during air raid alerts (Source: @DeepStateUA/23795).
points_4: Ukraine's Presidential Office announced a warehouse decentralization program to protect businesses from systematic Russian attacks. Working groups will assist entrepreneurs with relocating storage and production to safer locations in other oblasts (Source: @UkraineNow/83869).
points_5: Thirteen Ukrainians aged 27 to 87 were returned from occupation, including elderly and seriously ill individuals. Among the returnees was a couple from Kherson who had been in occupation since February 24, 2022 (Source: @UkraineNow/83867).

points: Moscow Mayor Sergey Sobyanin reported that air defense repelled an attack of 10 UAVs over Moscow. This was confirmed via TASS state news agency reporting (Source: @tass_agency/393629).
points_2: The Russian Embassy in Berlin warned that deployment sites of planned German long-range systems would become legitimate military targets if deployed against Russia, in a statement to Izvestia newspaper (Source: @tass_agency/393630).
points_3: Russian forces advanced near Holubivka and Stupochky according to a DeepState map update, indicating continued tactical progress in unspecified frontline sectors (Source: @DeepStateUA/23793).
points_4: Trump stated in a TASS interview that the Biden administration gave Kyiv ammunition worth hundreds of billions of dollars for free, more than the US used against Iran, and pledged to demand return of these funds (Source: @tass_agency/393628).

points: On the Kupiansk direction, the 23rd Assault Regiment R.U.G. of the 2nd Corps of the National Guard 'Khartiia' continued advancing and cleared new territory between Dvorichna and Zapadne. Ukrainian forces from the 35th Separate Marine Brigade operated jointly with R.U.G. on one sector, with 4 km² total liberated (Source: @DeepStateUA/23796).
points_2: Russian forces advanced near Holubivka and Stupochky according to a DeepState map update, though specific unit designations or distances were not provided in the source (Source: @DeepStateUA/23793).
points_3: A reactive drone targeted Lozova settlement from the south in Kharkiv Oblast, indicating continued aerial strikes in the eastern operational zone (Source: @kpszsu/76222).

points: Multiple reactive drones were tracked crossing from Chernihiv Oblast toward Kyiv Oblast, with at least one drone reported flying from Bryansk Oblast into Chernihiv Oblast, Chernihiv district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73606).
points_2: A reactive drone was reported near Nizhyn heading south, while another was tracked in the Lubny district of Poltava Oblast heading toward Cherkasy Oblast (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73631).
points_3: A drone from Chernihiv Oblast was reported heading toward Kyiv Oblast along with drones from Cherkasy and Vinnytsia oblasts, per air tracking channels (Source: @eRadarrua/110446).

points: Drones headed toward Zaporizhzhia from the south, and a reactive drone was reported heading toward Kryvyi Rih from the south, indicating aerial activity on the southern axis (Source: @kpszsu/76236).
points_2: A reactive drone west of Mykolaiv was reported heading north, while drones on the Odesa Oblast were tracked heading toward Vinnytsia Oblast (Source: @kpszsu/76226, @mon1tor_ua/73630).
points_3: Two reactive drones were tracked crossing from Donetsk Oblast to Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, suggesting continued aerial operations in the southern operational zone (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73630).

points: Russia deployed jet-powered Geran-5 drones launched from approximately 400 km against Ukraine. These drones resemble cruise missiles, can reach speeds up to 600 km/h, carry approximately 90 kg warheads, and have a range of up to 1000 km (Source: @UkraineNow/83864).
points_2: A logistics facility near Boryspil belonging to Biokon company was reported burning following a drone strike. Separately, a drone hit or was shot down on the outskirts of Vasylkiv (Source: @UkraineNow/83859, @mon1tor_ua/73604).
points_3: Numerous reactive drones targeted Kyiv throughout the night, with reports of drones heading toward Darnytsia, Lisovyi massif, Lukianivka, Podil, Solomianka, Vynohradar, DVRZ, and Vyshneve districts. Air defense activity was reported across multiple Kyiv neighborhoods (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73623, @mon1tor_ua/73624, @mon1tor_ua/73625, @mon1tor_ua/73629, @mon1tor_ua/73636, @mon1tor_ua/73639).
points_4: Multiple drones were tracked heading toward Bila Tserkva, Obukhiv, and Brovary on Kyiv Oblast from various directions including from the north of Cherkasy Oblast. Four drones were tracked converging on the Vasylkiv-Fastiv-Boiarka corridor (Source: @kpszsu/76237, @kpszsu/76243, @eRadarrua/110471).
points_5: Moscow Mayor Sobyanin reported air defense repelling a 10-UAV attack on Moscow, indicating Russian air defense was active during the same overnight period as attacks on Ukraine (Source: @tass_agency/393629).

key_developments: Russian jet-powered Geran-5 drones were downed over Kyiv for the second consecutive night, with launches originating from approximately 400 km, and drones reaching speeds up to 600 km/h with up to 1000 km range (Source: @UkraineNow/83864).
Ukrainian forces from the 23rd Assault Brigade R.U.G. and 35th Marine Brigade liberated 4 km² of territory near Dvorichna and Zapadne on the Kupiansk direction (Source: @DeepStateUA/23796).
A logistics facility near Boryspil belonging to Biokon company was reported burning following Russian drone strike on Kyiv Oblast (Source: @UkraineNow/83859).
Russian forces advanced near Holubivka and Stupochky, per DeepState map update (Source: @DeepStateUA/23793).
Russian Embassy in Berlin warned that planned German long-range system deployment sites would become legitimate military targets (Source: @tass_agency/393630).
Estonian Defense Minister Hanno Pevkur resigned after €70 million advance to Indian companies for Ukrainian artillery shells went undelivered (Source: @UkraineNow/83861).
Moscow Mayor Sobyanin reported air defense repelling 10-UAV attack on Moscow during overnight strikes on Ukraine (Source: @tass_agency/393629).
sections.threat_assessment: The overnight drone campaign represents a significant escalation in Russian aerial operations against Ukrainian infrastructure, with the deployment of advanced jet-powered Geran-5 drones capable of higher speeds and longer ranges than conventional Shahed variants. The concentration of strikes on Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast, including direct hits on logistics facilities near Boryspil, suggests deliberate targeting of supply chain infrastructure supporting Ukrainian operations. The Moscow UAV attack indicates a potential expansion of aerial warfare, though the source is Russian state media. The combination of ground advances near Holubivka and Stupochky alongside continued aerial pressure creates multi-domain operational pressure on Ukrainian defenders.
sections.regional_response: Estonian Defense Minister Hanno Pevkur's resignation over failed ammunition procurement highlights ongoing challenges in European military supply chains supporting Ukraine, with €70 million in advance payments to Indian-linked companies resulting in no delivered shells. Hungary's continued blocking of EU accession negotiations demonstrates persistent friction within European integration efforts. The Russian Embassy warning regarding German long-range systems signals escalating diplomatic tensions between Moscow and Berlin. These regional responses indicate both solidarity with and strain on its European backers.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Geran-5 deployment represents a notable technical evolution in Russian UAV capabilities, with jet propulsion enabling higher speeds and longer ranges that complicate Ukrainian air defense interception timelines. The coordination of drone strikes from multiple oblast approaches (Chernihiv, Poltava, Cherkasy, Dnipropetrovsk, Donetsk, Odesa) suggests systematic operational planning rather than ad hoc targeting. The Biokon logistics facility strike near Boryspil aligns with Russia's documented pattern of targeting Ukrainian supply chain nodes. The simultaneous Moscow air defense activity may indicate reciprocal drone exchanges or separate Ukrainian long-range operations.
